cc:Work.dc:description: An eight by eight matrix ordered A1 B1 C1 D1 A2 B2 C2 D2 uses crosses on the self diagonal, plus signs at A1/A2, B1/B2, C1/C2, D1/D2 and their mirrors, and minus signs elsewhere. Each row has one positive and six negatives.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52645a
font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #234c3c

g.text: Read one row: one positive, six negatives.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52645a

g.text: Four source images × two views = eight embeddings. Self-comparisons are masked.
